test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 14 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In an election, a candidate who got 73% of the total valid votes is elected by a majority of 1426 votes. If 20% of votes are invalid, then what is the total number of votes polled?
solution:
Given:

20% votes declare invalid votes.

The winner gets 73% of the valid votes.

The difference of votes of winner and looser votes is 1426.

Concept Used:

Total no. of votes = Valid Votes + Invalid Votes&l
